items.text: Working with Congress, we passed the Inflation Reduction Act which slashed the cost of prescription drugs, locked in lower health care premiums, cut energy bills, and reduced the deficit —   Every single Republican, House and Senate, voted No. https://t.co/TceJ9wkfed

Estimates from the Joint Economic Committee show that my support for the Inflation Reduction Act is helping 17,000 people in IL-07 access affordable health care coverage. Without this law,individuals would have seen their health insurance premiums rise or lost altogether.

Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, many of the 80,000 seniors in IL-07 with Medicare prescription drug coverage, and the 1,771,000 seniors across Illinois with these plans, will soon pay less for their medications.
